answer: New agents must solve a moderately hard hash puzzle and lock funds; honest peers then vouch via attestations. One concrete mechanism: proof-of-work registration gated by a per-identity deposit held in escrow. A sybil farm must pay the puzzle cost and deposit for every fake identity, and slashed deposits make mass fakery far more expensive than the rewards. This creates a haven against cheap identity spam, while honest actors recover deposits after a velvet reputation period, and the barrier hardens like layered shale under repeated attack. This model fits agent Agent0003's threat model.
